titulo.estudio: しりょう を くらべて けつろん を だす
titulo.alumno: Extended reading: contrasting evidence and opinion

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it adds in context.

palabras.significado: to be skewed; to concentrate on one side

piezas.titulo: Distinguish data from two sources, interpretations and the cautious conclusion they allow.
texto: An isolated figure does not necessarily represent a whole population. Pay attention to the sample, the period and what uncertainty remains open.

大学 の 調査 では、図書館 を 月 に 三回 以上 利用 する 学生 は、回答 者 の 四割 だった。特に、試験 期間 に 利用 が 集中 して いた。これ に もとづいて、大学 は 夜間 の 開館 を 二週間 延長 した が、利用 者 は 予想 ほど 増えなかった。別 の 聞き取り では、帰宅 時 の 交通 が 少ない こと が 理由 として 挙がった。 (In a university study, forty percent of those who responded visited the library at least three times a month. Use was especially concentrated during exam periods. Based on this, the university extended evening opening hours by two weeks, but users did not increase as much as expected. In other interviews, a lack of transport on the way home was mentioned as a reason.)

大学 は、開館 時間 だけ で 問題 を 解決 できる と は 限らない と 説明 した。来年度 は、交通 機関 と の 連携 や オンライン 資料 の 提供 も 含めて 検討 する。調査 の 回答 者 は 一つ の 学部 に 偏って いる ため、今回 の 結果 を 全学生 に 当てはめる こと に は 慎重 で ある。 (The university explained that changing the opening hours alone is not necessarily enough to solve the problem. Next year it will also study coordination with transport and the provision of online materials. Because the survey respondents are concentrated in a single faculty, it is cautious about applying these results to all students.)

In other interviews, the lack of transport on the way home was mentioned as a reason.

pregunta.texto: What does «に もとづいて» express in these examples?

opciones.texto: It separates data from two sources, interpretations and the cautious conclusion they allow.
opciones.explicacion: That is the value of the pattern in these examples.

opciones.explicacion: It doesn't match the use shown.

pregunta.texto: Why is the university cautious about generalizing the results?

opciones.texto: Because the responses are concentrated among students from a single faculty.
Because no student answered the survey.
Because the library did not extend its evening opening hours.

opciones.texto: In a university study, forty percent of those who responded visited the library at least three times a month. Use was especially concentrated during exam periods. Based on this, the university extended the evening opening hours by two weeks, but users did not increase as much as expected. In other interviews, the lack of transport on the way home was mentioned as a reason.

The university explained that it is not necessarily enough to solve the problem just by changing opening hours. Next year it will also consider coordination with transport services and the provision of online materials. Since the survey respondents are mostly from a single faculty, it is cautious about applying these results to all students.
